knowledge_store.content: Project Repository Hygiene Rule: All development notes must be stored in ./copilot-notes/ directory to keep project root clean and avoid clutter. Dev notes are valuable for reference and communication during development but should not live permanently in the repository.

Commit Practice Rule: Avoid wrapping development notes in commits. Development notes should stay in ./copilot-notes/ and not be committed to avoid byte waste and bit rot. Changes and motivations should be captured in commit messages instead.

Documentation Hierarchy Rule: Major achievements and obscure technical details that need permanent documentation should go in ./docs/ directory as user documentation. This is for Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and important technical documentation that users need to reference.

Commit Message Strategy: Commit messages should capture change motivations and rationale rather than relying on separate documentation files. This keeps the reasoning close to the code changes and maintains clean repository hygiene.

Enhanced Search Strategy Protocol: When initial memory search doesn't provide enough confidence to proceed, conduct expanded search using different thresholds, workload types, and tier preferences. If relevant information is found, semantically link it by modifying tags on stored items in near-real-time. Only ask user for assistance if expanded search still fails to meet confidence requirements.

Development Requirement: Implement memory_update_knowledge tool in Mnemosyne memory system. This tool should allow updating existing knowledge items including content, metadata, tags, and importance levels. Essential for enabling semantic linking workflow where related knowledge items can be connected through tag updates in near-real-time during expanded searches.

Tool Specification: memory_update_knowledge should accept parameters including knowledge item ID, updated content (optional), updated metadata (optional), updated tags (optional), and updated importance (optional). Should return confirmation of successful update and any validation errors. This enables selective updates without requiring full knowledge re-storage.

Memory Export Request: User wants full memory export to .mnemosyne directory for state rehydration capability. This will enable tools to reload memory state from exported files, creating persistent memory across sessions.
